note: Tennessee State Parks' primitive drive-up campground at Foster Falls, the only vehicle camping in Fiery Gizzard State Park (formerly South Cumberland). Wooded back-in gravel pads on a one-way loop, a bathhouse with heated showers, no water at the sites and no gas generators. The park pitches it for tents and small trailers; posted pad lengths run 13-50 ft, and only about half the sites take 23 ft or more (3, 4, 8, 9, 11, 16, 19, 21, 22, 23 and 25 among them). Every site carries an unquantified height restriction. --Claude
summary: Operating, renamed: South Cumberland SP is now Fiery Gizzard State Park. 25 primitive back-in gravel sites (no hookups, no water at sites, bathhouse with heated showers), open year-round, reservable on the TN engine; $27/$30 (to $28/$31 from July 2027), $52 holiday weekends. Posted max RV 13-50 ft: 15 sites at 23 ft+, 10 under. Agency wording pitches it for 'tents and small trailers'.
flags: CRITERIA (reviewer's call, not dropped): the agency describes the campground as 'ideal for tents or small trailers', 'available for tents and small trailers', and 'the only camping area in the park where guests may park a car and/or small pop-ups next to the campsite'; every site carries the feature 'Height Restriction' (no figure given). This reads as discouraging larger rigs but is not an explicit 'motorhomes/trailers not recommended'. Against it, the reserve engine posts Max RV of 23 ft or more on 15 of the 25 sites (2=26, 3=25, 4=50, 5=25, 6=25, 7=25, 8=30, 9=30, 11=27, 13=25, 16=26, 19=28, 21=31, 22=34, 23=31, 25=23). Under 23 ft: 1 (13), 10, 12, 14 (18), 15 (19), 17 (16), 18, 20, 24 (22). The old note's 'Vehicle limit 25 ft ... total tow combo under ~30 ft, narrow turns' had no source found on the current pages and has been dropped. Height restriction unquantified - an overhanging-canopy limit could matter for a 10.5-ft rig; not resolvable from the pages read.
